title: Integrating machine learning and molecular dynamics simulation to decipher the molecular network of dioxin-associated liposarcoma.
authors: Chenhe, Zhang; Aobo, Zhuang; Xiao, Zhou; Han, Gao; Longshang, Wang; Zhe, Xi; Yingxue, Cheng; Huichen, Li; Jincheng, Wu; Wei, Zeng; Wengang, Li
one_liner_zh: 该研究结合机器学习与分子动力学模拟解析二噁英相关脂肪肉瘤的分子网络，虽涉及蛋白互作与模拟，但核心非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Dioxin-like pollutants, especially 2,3,7,8-Tetrachlorodibenzo-p-dioxin, are recognized human carcinogens. Retrospective studies suggest a link between dioxins and soft tissue sarcomas, including liposarcoma, but mechanisms remain unclear. This study explores the toxicological effects of dioxins on liposarcoma, identifies key proteins, and proposes potential solutions. We identified dioxin- and liposarcoma-related targets via databases, analyzed overlaps through enrichment and network toxicology, and validated them with phenotypic and clinical data. We built a prediction model using 117 combinations of machine learning algorithms, confirmed the results with molecular docking and simulations, and proposed therapies through drug experiments. TCDD modulates adipocytic malignancy through activation of xenobiotic response pathways, disruption of cellular metabolism, and interactions with cancer-related receptors. AhR partially mediates this toxicological effect, and five key proteins, including CDH3, ADORA2B, MMP14, IP6K2, and HTR2A, are used to predict the development of dioxin-related liposarcoma. The selective HTR2A receptor antagonist ketanserin has the potential to alleviate this toxicological impact. Our study presents an efficient, cost-effective toxicological analysis using network toxicology, offering new insights into dioxin-associated liposarcoma.
abstract_zh: 二噁英类污染物，尤其是2,3,7,8-四氯二苯并对二噁英，是公认的人类致癌物。回顾性研究表明，二噁英与软组织肉瘤（包括脂肪肉瘤）之间存在关联，但其机制尚不清楚。本研究探讨二噁英对脂肪肉瘤的毒理学效应，识别关键蛋白质，并提出潜在解决方案。我们通过数据库鉴定了二噁英和脂肪肉瘤相关靶点，通过富集分析和网络毒理学检查重叠部分，并用表型和临床数据验证了这些靶点。我们使用117种机器学习算法组合构建了预测模型，通过分子对接和模拟确认了结果，并通过药物实验提出了治疗方案。TCDD通过激活外源物响应通路、干扰细胞代谢以及与癌症相关受体的相互作用来调节脂肪细胞恶性程度。AhR部分介导了这种毒理学效应，五个关键蛋白质，包括CDH3、ADORA2B、MMP14、IP6K2和HTR2A，被用于预测二噁英相关脂肪肉瘤的发展。选择性HTR2A受体拮抗剂酮色林具有缓解这种毒理学影响的潜力。我们的研究利用网络毒理学提供了一种高效、成本效益高的毒理学分析方法，为二噁英相关脂肪肉瘤提供了新见解。
